steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each cited standard is matched to the map with its edition and clause.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Citation has no edition
findings.fix: Add the edition the map lists

findings.title: Clause not in the map
findings.fix: Check the clause against the published standard

findings.title: Edition differs from the map
findings.fix: Update the citation to the mapped edition

outcome.notChecked: the current edition of any standard, unless a reviewer has checked it against the publisher; whether a clause means what the skill says; standards not in the map at all.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] skill-web-security.md:12  Citation has no edition.
       Fix: Add the edition the map lists.
[medium] skill-quality.md:19  Clause not in the map.
       Fix: Check the clause against the published standard.
[low] skill-finance.md:26  Edition differs from the map.
       Fix: Update the citation to the mapped edition.
Not checked: the current edition of any standard, unless a reviewer has checked it against the publisher; whether a clause means what the skill says; standards not in the map at all.
pros: Flags a citation with no edition, a clause not in the map, an edition different from the map, or a standard not in the map at all.
cons: Not checked: the current edition of any standard, unless a reviewer has checked it against the publisher; whether a clause means what the skill says; standards not in the map at all.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-core-standards-map skill on the records for this review.
